intro.title: Gemstone Laxmi Charan Paduka
intro.descriptionHtml: Powerful Laxmi Charan carved perfectly in100% natural Gemstones, like different colours of Jade, Quartz Crystal, Lapis Lazuli, Ruby, Gomed etc. The Laxmi Charan symbolizes the Divine Lotus feet of Goddess Lakshmi, who showers prosperity, wealth, fertility, property, good fortune, beauty and abundance. The various Gemstones which it is carved on, have their individual properties and add to the benefits. They serve as good luck gifts and can be kept at home or office.
